title: Independence assumption for query and key components
description: The scaling factor 1/sqrt(d_k) in dot-product attention is motivated by assuming that the components of queries and keys are independent random variables with mean 0 and variance 1, which may not hold for learned representations.
canonical_description: assumption that query and key components are independent random variables with zero mean and unit variance to justify scaling factor

evidence.quote: assume that the components of q and k are independent random variables with mean 0 and variance 1
